entities.blurb: Elytra are endgame equipment found exclusively in End ships, which are located in the outer islands of the End. While worn in the chest armor slot, they allow for gliding by pressing jump while in midair. Firework rockets can be used for propulsion while gliding.
entities.name: Elytra

entities.blurb: Emeralds are minerals that are used primarily as the currency for trading with villagers and wandering traders. They are mainly obtained from trading goods for them, killing illager mobs (vindicators and evokers specifically), and through mining the highly rare emerald ore in mountain biomes.
entities.name: Emerald

wanted.name: Book and Quill
wanted.note: In [[Java Edition|''Java Edition'']] only one is requested per trade because of [[Mojira:MC-248042|MC-248042]] – Librarian's book and quill trade is always discounted to 1 since books are unstackable. In [[Bedrock Edition|''Bedrock Edition'']], the second book is placed in another slot instead.

entities.blurb: An enchanted book is a type of book that stores one or more enchantments of any type. It can be applied to any valid item using an anvil, which enchants the item and consumes the book.
entities.name: Enchanted Book

given.name: Enchanted Book
given.note: A random [[enchantment]] other than [[Soul Speed]], [[Swift Sneak]], and [[Wind Burst]] is picked with equal chances, followed by a random level. A villager can offer the same book multiple times.

entities.blurb: An enchanted golden apple is an uncraftable food item that, upon consumption, grants much more powerful effects than a regular golden apple. Despite its name and enchantment glint, enchanted golden apples do not actually have any enchantments.
entities.name: Enchanted Golden Apple

entities.blurb: An End crystal is an entity that can be crafted or found on the End's main island, where it heals the ender dragon. It can be placed only on obsidian or bedrock, and it explodes instantly when attacked or damaged in most ways.
entities.name: End Crystal

entities.blurb: A spawn egg is an item used to instantly spawn mobs.
entities.name: Ender Dragon Spawn Egg

entities.blurb: An eye of ender is a craftable item that can be thrown in the Overworld to show the direction of the nearest stronghold, which may break the eye. 12 eyes of ender are required to activate a stronghold's End portal (which may generate with some of the eyes already in place), which leads to the End dimension.
entities.name: Eye of Ender

entities.blurb: An ender pearl is an item that can be thrown to teleport to where it lands, or used to craft eyes of ender, which are required to access the End.
entities.name: Ender Pearl

entities.blurb: A spawn egg is an item used to instantly spawn mobs.
entities.name: Enderman Spawn Egg

entities.blurb: A spawn egg is an item used to instantly spawn mobs.
entities.name: Endermite Spawn Egg

entities.blurb: A spawn egg is an item used to instantly spawn mobs.
entities.name: Evoker Spawn Egg

entities.blurb: A bottle o' enchanting is an item that can be thrown to break it and release experience orbs.
entities.name: Bottle o' Enchanting

entities.blurb: An explorer pottery sherd is a pottery sherd that depicts a map. It can be found in cold ocean ruins.
entities.name: Explorer Pottery Sherd

entities.blurb: An eye armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, end stone, and seven diamonds.
entities.name: Eye Armor Trim Smithing Template

entities.blurb: Feathers are items dropped by chickens and parrots, and can be found in loot chests of certain structures. Tamed cats may give players feathers as morning gifts.
entities.name: Feather

entities.blurb: A fermented spider eye is an item used to corrupt the effects of certain potions via brewing, and it is required to brew potions of Weakness.
entities.name: Fermented Spider Eye

entities.blurb: A field masoned banner pattern is a banner pattern used to customize banners with a shape of bricks.
entities.name: Field Masoned Banner Pattern

entities.blurb:
A map or locator map is an item used to view explored surface terrain and players. Maps can be cloned, zoomed out and locked using a cartography table.
A (non-locator) map is a variant in Bedrock Edition which does not show players.
entities.name: Map

entities.blurb: A fire charge is an item that can be used as a single-use version of a flint and steel or shot as a small fireball from a dispenser.
entities.name: Fire Charge

entities.blurb:
A firework rocket is an item that provides a speed boost when used while flying with elytra. It can also be launched as a projectile either by hand or from a crossbow or dispenser.
It can also be crafted using extra gunpowder to fly farther or with up to seven firework stars to add customizable damage-dealing explosions.
entities.name: Firework Rocket

entities.blurb: A firework star is a crafting ingredient used to create explosive firework rockets, which deal damage based on the number of stars added. Firework stars can be crafted using various combinations of dyes and other items, which affect the appearance, colors, and visual effects of the resulting explosions.
entities.name: Firework Star

entities.blurb: A fishing rod is a tool that casts a bobber used to fish in water or to hook and pull mobs, items‌[JE  only], and some other entities toward the player.
entities.name: Fishing Rod

entities.blurb: Flint is an item obtained from mining gravel that can be used to craft a flint and steel, a fletching table, and arrows.
entities.name: Flint

entities.blurb: Flint and steel is a tool used to create fire or to ignite certain blocks, structures and mobs.
entities.name: Flint and Steel

entities.blurb: Flow armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, a breeze rod, and seven diamonds.
entities.name: Flow Armor Trim Smithing Template

entities.blurb: A flow banner pattern is a banner pattern used to customize banners with a shape of a spiral. It can only be found in trial chambers and cannot be crafted.
entities.name: Flow Banner Pattern

entities.blurb: A flow pottery sherd is a pottery sherd that depicts a spiral or a wind charge. It can be found in trial chambers.
entities.name: Flow Pottery Sherd

entities.blurb: A flower charge banner pattern is a banner pattern used to customize banners with a shape of a flower.
entities.name: Flower Charge Banner Pattern

entities.blurb: A spawn egg is an item used to instantly spawn mobs.
entities.name: Fox Spawn Egg

entities.blurb: A friend pottery sherd is a pottery sherd that depicts the unibrow and nose of a villager or iron golem. The design features a unibrow spanning the entire forehead and lacks a mouth, making the icon particularly similar to the facial features of an iron golem. However, this is difficult to determine with certainty. It can be found in trail ruins.
entities.name: Friend Pottery Sherd

entities.blurb: A spawn egg is an item used to instantly spawn mobs.
entities.name: Frog Spawn Egg

entities.blurb: A minecart with furnace is a furnace inside a minecart. It can be powered with exclusively coal or charcoal to propel it across a rail line for a limited time, which can be used to move other minecarts.
entities.name: Minecart with Furnace

entities.blurb: A spawn egg is an item used to instantly spawn mobs.
entities.name: Ghast Spawn Egg

entities.blurb: Ghast tears are items dropped by ghasts that are used to make dried ghasts, End crystals, and potions of Regeneration.
entities.name: Ghast Tear

entities.blurb: A glass bottle is an item that can hold water, potions, honey, or dragon's breath.
entities.name: Glass Bottle

entities.blurb: A glistering melon slice is an inedible item used as a brewing ingredient for potions of Healing.
entities.name: Glistering Melon Slice

entities.blurb: The globe banner pattern is a banner pattern used to customize banners with a shape of a cube-shaped earth. It can only be obtained from trading and cannot be crafted.
entities.name: Globe Banner Pattern

entities.blurb:
Glow berries are a food item obtained from cave vines and can be used to plant them.
Cave vines are a climbable plant that hangs off ceilings and grows glow berries. Cave vines with glow berries produce light.
entities.name: Glow Berries

entities.blurb: A glow ink sac is an item dropped by a glow squid upon death. It can be used on signs to make the text glow and can be used to craft glow item frames.
entities.name: Glow Ink Sac

entities.blurb: A glow item frame is an entity‌[JE  only] or block‌[BE  only] that keeps itself and the item inside of it illuminated, even in the dark.
entities.name: Glow Item Frame

entities.blurb: A spawn egg is an item used to instantly spawn mobs.
entities.name: Glow Squid Spawn Egg

entities.blurb: Glowstone dust is an item obtained from mining glowstone, and it is mainly used to brew potions with increased strength and decreased duration.
entities.name: Glowstone Dust

entities.blurb: A goat horn is a horn dropped by goats. It has eight variants, and each plays a unique sound when used which can be heard by players in a large radius.
entities.name: Goat Horn

entities.blurb: A spawn egg is an item used to instantly spawn mobs.
entities.name: Goat Spawn Egg

entities.blurb: A gold ingot is a metal ingot smelted from raw gold or crafted with nine gold nuggets. It is used to craft armor, tools, and items, as well as being used as currency for bartering with piglins.
entities.name: Gold Ingot

entities.blurb: Gold nuggets are small pieces of gold used to craft gold ingots and other various golden items. They can be obtained by smelting golden tools, weapons, or armor, or by mining Nether gold ore. One gold nugget is effectively worth one-ninth of a gold ingot.
entities.name: Gold Nugget

entities.blurb: A golden apple is a food item that bestows beneficial effects when consumed (Absorption and Regeneration) and is also used to cure a zombie villager under the Weakness effect into a normal villager. It is a variant of a normal apple.
entities.name: Golden Apple

entities.blurb: A golden axe is a variant of axe that is crafted from gold ingots. It can be used to cut down trees faster, to strip logs and scrape copper-based blocks, and as a melee weapon that disables shields. It is the sixth-highest tier of axe, having the lowest durability, and having the lowest attack damage alongside wooden axes, despite having the highest mining efficiency and the highest attack speed alongside diamond and netherite axes. It can be admired by piglins, and has the highest enchantability.
entities.name: Golden Axe

entities.blurb: Golden boots are a variant of boots crafted from gold ingots. They are the sixth-highest tier of boots, having the same armor points as leather boots but with higher durability and enchantability. Like all golden armor, piglins are attracted to golden boots, and do not attack any player wearing them.
entities.name: Golden Boots

entities.blurb: A golden carrot is a food item that provides the most saturation out of all stackable foods when eaten. It is also a brewing ingredient for potions of Night Vision. In Java Edition, due to its high saturation, a golden carrot restores the most health via saturation boost of any stackable food item.
entities.name: Golden Carrot

entities.blurb: A golden chestplate is a variant of chestplate crafted from gold ingots. It is the fifth-highest tier of chestplate, having higher armor points than a copper chestplate. Like all golden armor, piglins are attracted to golden chestplates, and will not attack any player that is wearing one.
entities.name: Golden Chestplate

entities.blurb: A golden helmet is a variant of helmet that is crafted from gold ingots. It is the seventh-highest tier of helmet, having higher armor points and durability than a leather cap. Like all golden armor, piglins are attracted to golden helmets, and do not attack any player wearing one.
entities.name: Golden Helmet

entities.blurb: A golden hoe is a variant of hoe that is crafted from gold ingots. It is used to till dirt-related blocks into farmland, and to break leaves, haybales, and sculk-related blocks faster. It is the sixth-highest tier of hoe, having the lowest durability, and having the lowest attack speed alongside wooden hoes, despite having the highest mining efficiency. It can be admired by piglins, and has the highest enchantability.
entities.name: Golden Hoe

entities.blurb: Golden horse armor is the third-strongest tier of horse armor. Unlike other gold items, it cannot be crafted and is only obtainable from chest loot in various structures.
entities.name: Golden Horse Armor

entities.blurb: Golden leggings are a variant of leggings crafted from gold ingots. They are the sixth-highest tier of leggings, having higher armor points and durability than leather pants. Like all golden armor, piglins are attracted to golden leggings, and do not attack any player wearing them.
entities.name: Golden Leggings

entities.blurb: Golden nautilus armor is a type of nautilus armor that can be equipped by a nautilus that reduces the damage received to the nautilus. It is the third-strongest tier of nautilus armor, having higher armor points than iron nautilus armor.
entities.name: Golden Nautilus Armor

entities.blurb: A golden pickaxe is a variant of pickaxe that is crafted from gold ingots. It is the sixth-highest tier of pickaxe, having the lowest durability, and having the lowest attack damage alongside wooden pickaxes, despite having the highest mining efficiency. It has a mining level of 0, the same as a wooden pickaxe, allowing it to mine stone and coal ore. It can be admired by piglins, and has the highest enchantability.
entities.name: Golden Pickaxe

entities.blurb: A golden shovel is a variant of shovel that is crafted from gold ingots. It is used to break dirt, sand, gravel and other related blocks faster, to create dirt paths from dirt-related blocks, and to extinguish campfires. It is the sixth-highest tier of shovel, having the lowest durability, and having the lowest attack damage alongside wooden shovels, despite having the highest mining efficiency. It can be admired by piglins, and has the highest enchantability.
entities.name: Golden Shovel

entities.blurb: A golden spear is a variant of spear crafted from gold ingots. It can be used to perform slow jab attacks or held forward to deal increasing damage based on how quickly the wielder is moving. It is the seventh-highest tier of spear, dealing the same damage as a wooden spear but with lower attack speed and durability. It can be admired by piglins, and has the highest enchantability.
entities.name: Golden Spear

entities.blurb: A golden sword is a variant of sword crafted from gold ingots. It is the seventh-highest tier of sword, dealing the same damage as a wooden sword but having less durability. It can be admired by piglins, and has the highest enchantability.
entities.name: Golden Sword
